Faltantes, daños o diferencias de especificación

image.prompt: Create a premium editorial illustration for Obra Clara, an Argentine construction payments product. Wide landscape composition 3:2. Sophisticated warm off-white background #f3f1e9, deep charcoal outlines #192522, vivid construction orange #ff641b, restrained sage green #267d58 and blue #37759a. A precise hand-drawn architectural cutaway / isometric ink-and-gouache drawing: at center a transparent glass escrow vault containing neat abstract money tokens and a bold orange padlock; at right a 10-story unfinished concrete building, tower crane, a delivery truck carrying cement bags and an engineer with orange safety helmet confirming a delivery on a tablet; at left a contractor places payment tokens into the vault. Thin elegant illustrated route lines connect the three elements; a small portion of tokens follows a green path toward the supplier only after the engineer confirmation, remaining tokens visibly stay locked in the vault. Emphasize held funds as the visual focal point (45% of composition), trust and construction materials delivery. High-end financial editorial storytelling, clean spacious composition, detailed yet calm, slight natural paper texture, no glossy 3D clipart, no stock-photo look, no robots, no storefronts, no shopping cart. No text, no numbers, no letters, no logos or typography anywhere. All visual elements fully within frame. Must look like a bespoke product landing illustration, consistent single illustration not a collage.

drawings: Custom inline SVG: escrow flow and return path; three problem sketches; lock; security shield. Existing logo untouched.
